name: @joeybuilt/fonto-bridge
description: Proxies tool calls to Fonto's data API for asset, collection, and tag operations.
author: Joeybuilt LLC

capabilitiesRationale.storage:read: Reads the Fonto connection credentials (fonto_user_id) to authenticate data API calls.

tools.name: fonto.asset.list
tools.description: List active assets in the user's Fonto workspace.

tools.name: fonto.asset.search
tools.description: Search assets by filename, AI description, or extracted text.

tools.name: fonto.asset.tag
tools.description: Apply a tag to an asset.

tools.name: fonto.asset.untag
tools.description: Remove a tag from an asset.

tools.name: fonto.collection.list
tools.description: List collections (curated asset groups) in the user's Fonto workspace.

tools.name: fonto.collection.create
tools.description: Create a new collection in the user's Fonto workspace.

tools.name: fonto.collection.add_asset
tools.description: Add an asset to a collection.

tools.name: fonto.collection.remove_asset
tools.description: Remove an asset from a collection.

tools.name: fonto.tag.list
tools.description: List tags (labels) in the user's Fonto workspace.

tools.name: fonto.tag.create
tools.description: Create a new tag in the user's Fonto workspace.
